_note: Venus Xtravaganza - facts for an In memoriam page (28 Nov 2026). Source: English Wikipedia 'Venus Xtravaganza' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venus_Xtravaganza), checked today.
born: Venus Pellagatti, 5 May 1965, Jersey City, New Jersey (Italian-American and Puerto Rican parents)
died: Found dead 21 December 1988 at the Fulton Hotel, 264 West 46th Street, New York; strangled. The murder was never solved; NYPD reopened the case in 2022.
house: Invited into the House of Xtravaganza in 1983 by its founder Hector Xtravaganza (Hector Valle); after he died in 1985, Mother Angie Xtravaganza took her as her drag daughter.
film: One of the central storylines of Jennie Livingston's documentary Paris Is Burning (1990), released after her death; the film's last scenes show Angie learning of it.
later: The documentary I'm Your Venus (2024) follows her family and the House of Xtravaganza pushing to reopen the case.
in_the_episodes: James St. James names her twice talking to Christina Visca (S06E02, 00:27:03 and 00:27:28).
